test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Vicky can complete a piece of work in 40 days. He worked for 8 days, then Gurpreet Singh finished it in 32 days. In how many days can Vicky and Gurpreet Singh together complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Vicky can complete the work in 40 days,

Vicky worked for 8 days and the rest work was finished by Gurpreet Singh in 32 days.

**Calculations:**

No of the days taken by Vicky to finish the work= 40

So part of the work done by Vicky in 1 day= 1/40

Part of work done by Vicky in 8 days= 8/40 = 1/5

The remaining part = 1 - (1)/(5) = (4)/(5)

No of days taken by Gurpreet to finish 4/5 part = 32

Part of the work done by Gurpreet in 1 day = (frac{4)/(5)}{32}

=(4)/(5)×(1)/(32) = (1)/(40)

Part of work done by both together in 1 day = (1/40) + (1/40) = 2/40 = 1/20

So, the number of days taken both together to finish the work = 1/(1/20) = 20 days

**Hence, They both can together complete the work in 20 days.**
